classification: PROJECT NUMERICAL ACCEPTANCE CRITERION — not physiology
selection_policy: Select the first (coarsest) candidate in candidate_dt_order_ms that passes every requirement against reference_dt_ms; otherwise use reference_dt_ms only if analytical and boundary semantics pass.
spike_time_requirement: Each ordered matched spike differs from the 0.1 ms run by no more than the candidate dt.
schedule_alignment_rule: All convergence stimulus changes occur at integer-millisecond boundaries exactly represented by 0.5, 0.25, and 0.1 ms grids.
